# Run ledger — P26.7 (state DOT/511 traffic-camera registries: a new source class)

## Spec / Base / Branch / Config

- **Spec:** `docs/tickets/P26.7__dot-511-camera-feeds.md` (SOURCES.7).
- **Branch:** `devin/p26-7-dot-camera-feeds` — stacked on
  `devin/p26-6-agenda-content-claims` (PR #98).
- **Date:** 2026-09-17. Engineering under GL-GATE-06 + ADR-087; every host's
  robots decides, never bypassed. Registry rows only — feed content
  (image/video/stream fields) is never fetched or emitted (Part VIII).

## What landed

### 1. The `dot_511` connector (`connectors/src/connectors/dot_511.py`)

A new source class: state DOT / 511 traffic-camera **location registries** —
operator-published camera censuses, the authoritative physical-layer complement
to the crowdsourced OSM `man_made=surveillance` layer. One connector serves all
states; each state is its own `dot_511_<st>` source row so rights/robots/cadence
stay per-host granular.

- **Eight stages** (`discover → fetch → capture → parse → extract → normalize →
  link → load`); `fetch` egresses through the shared politeness layer only;
  every post-capture stage is a pure function of captured bytes.
- **Deterministic page targets.** `registry_targets()` expands each verified
  `[[targets]]` row of `data/dot_511_targets.toml` into ArcGIS REST `query`
  page URLs — `resultOffset`/`resultRecordCount`/`orderByFields` over the
  layer's recorded `object_id_field`. This was **driven by a real defect found
  live**: ArcGIS Online hosted layers cap a query response at
  `maxRecordCount=1000` — the first live run silently truncated IL (2,937→1,000)
  and OR (1,180→1,000). Pages are planned from the layer's recorded
  `observed_count`; if a registry grows past its planned range the last page's
  `exceededTransferLimit` flag raises `ContentDrift` — never a silently
  truncated census. (The flag on a *middle* page is expected and tolerated.)
- **Field aliases as data** (`data/dot_511_vocab.toml`, vocab `2026.09.17`):
  `CAMERAID`/`CAM_ID__`/`device_id`/`OBJECTID`/`ObjectId`, `latitude`/`y`/
  `attributes_latitude`, `highway`/`Route`/`roadway`/`RoadwayName`,
  `District_Name`/`CamRegion`, … — first present non-empty alias wins; the
  matched field name rides the claim's `coordinate_source` for provenance.
  Attribute lat/lon is preferred over geometry (a published attribute is
  stronger provenance); point geometry (`x`=lon/`y`=lat at outSR=4326) is the
  fallback for geometry-only layers (WSDOT, KC/WSDOT, UDOT).
- **Sensitivity policy at claim time** (§43.3 / SIG-PUB-004): every coordinate
  is range-checked then passed through `policy.sensitivity.apply_tier` at the
  target's class (default C1 — operator-published hardware on public
  right-of-way → tier 0 exact). Malformed/missing/out-of-range coordinates and
  missing registry keys fail closed as `camera_record_rejected` rows
  (`missing`/`malformed`/`out_of_range`/`no_registry_key`/
  `tier_forbids_geometry`/`invalid_sensitivity_class`/`unmatched_target`) —
  recorded, never silent. A 100%-rejection capture is `ContentDrift` (a schema
  change, not an empty registry).
- **Media blocklist** (Part VIII): fields whose names carry feed content
  (`snapshot`, `*url*`, `*image*`, `*video*`, `hls*`, `*stream*`, `*thumb*`,
  `*fileloc*`, `URL1`/`URL2`, `CCTVPublicURL`, `STREAM_ERROR`, …) are dropped at
  extraction — only their NAMES persist on the entity row's `excluded_fields`
  so a reviewer sees the feed fields were present and deliberately refused.
  Feed-content URLs are never followed.
- **Claims:** `traffic_camera` entity row + `camera_external_ref`,
  `external_id`, `camera_jurisdiction` (with a `us.state_abbr` candidate
  identifier — never a resolution, SIG-INGEST-034), `camera_operator`,
  `camera_latitude`/`camera_longitude` (post-tier), `camera_coordinate_source`,
  and the optional `camera_name`/`camera_roadway`/`camera_county`/
  `camera_status`/`camera_direction` — all inside a hard predicate allowlist
  (SIG-INGEST-033); every claim carries evidence (source URL, retrieval date,
  `arcgis_feature_json` method) + a `Locator.row()` locator.
- **`canary_findings`** (SIG-PARSE-008): shape checks — features list, per-feature
  attributes map, numeric geometry — no field-name assertions (naming drift is
  handled by the vocabulary as data).

### 2. The sourced enumeration (`data/dot_511_targets.toml`)

Two row kinds, both committed:

- **14 verified `[[targets]]`** across 13 state source rows — ArcGIS feature
  layers for KY (254), IL (2,937), UT (32, geometry-only), OR (1,180), LA (435),
  IA (1,251), WA (1,705 + KC/WSDOT 125), DC (235, MapServer layer), GA (3,830),
  AL (556), MO (871 — layer is `FeatureServer/1`, not `/0`), TX (2,798),
  MD (552). Each row carries `arcgis_item_id`, `enum_source`,
  `observed_count`, `observed_fields`, `coordinate_mode`, `license_spdx`,
  `object_id_field` (from the captured `objectIdFieldName`), and `rights_note`.
- **27 `[[enumerated]]` non-target outcomes** — recorded, never dropped:
  `keyed_api` (Iteris-platform FL/NY/AZ/NV/PA/WI/AK/CT + tri-state
  NewEngland511 — all answer `Invalid Key`; HG-09 credential acts owed),
  `access_restricted` (OHGO 401), `robots_unretrievable` (WV/VA/TN/NC — 200-HTML
  or interstitial bodies are unparseable policy = not granted, SIG-INGEST-012;
  CA Caltrans CWWP robots 500), `spa_shell` (NE/MA/MN/IA-web/KS/CO), `not_found`
  (WY/KY-web/NM), `unreachable` (drivetexas, Idaho AGOL, FL511_Feeds), and
  `unresolved_rights` (the runneals-owned NC/PA/NJ ArcGIS mirrors — non-state
  publisher authority).

**≥30 distinct state surfaces probed; 13 states attempted through the
deterministic + live-gated path** (the ticket's ≥10 bar).

### 3. Rights dispositions (GL-GATE-06; packets in `docs/build/reports/rights/`)

| source | licence | posture | basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dot_511_ky` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | KYTC no-warranty disclaimer, no use restriction; state public record |
| `dot_511_il` | CC-BY-SA-2.0 | **flipped** | explicit CC-BY-SA-2.0 in item licenseInfo → own `dot511_ccbysa2` compartment |
| `dot_511_ut` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | informational/no-warranty notice; state public record |
| `dot_511_or` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | item licenseInfo `Public` (Oregon_OEM/ODOT) |
| `dot_511_ia` | CC-BY-4.0 | **flipped** | explicit CC-BY-4.0 |
| `dot_511_wa` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | WSDOT "intended for low volume use; may cancel/restrict" — conditional public grant; monthly cadence satisfies the condition (public terms only — no outreach) |
| `dot_511_dc` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | DC Data Policy (Mayor's Order 2017-115): Level 0 Open / CC0 dedication |
| `dot_511_mo` | CC0-1.0 | **flipped** | MO Terms of Use conditional grant (disclaimers + revocation) under public terms |
| `dot_511_la` | UNDETERMINED | gated | GOHSEP-owned item, EMPTY licenseInfo |
| `dot_511_ga` | UNDETERMINED | gated | GEMA-owned item, EMPTY licenseInfo |
| `dot_511_al` | UNDETERMINED | gated | county E-911 GIS publisher (bce911gis), not ALDOT + EMPTY licenseInfo |
| `dot_511_tx` | UNDETERMINED | gated | personal account (dkarctur), not TxDOT org + EMPTY licenseInfo |
| `dot_511_md` | UNDETERMINED | gated | iMAP attribution-conditioned terms — no registered SPDX expression yet |

`compact_status` stays `public_terms_only` on the flipped rows — the WA/MO
conditional grants are public-terms evaluations, not fabricated outreach
outcomes (the Stage-0 record test enforces this). `licenses.toml` gained
`CC-BY-SA-2.0` (self-relicensable share-alike) + the `dot511_ccbysa2`
compartment.

### 4. Wiring

- `__init__.py` registers the connector; `runner.py` `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE`
  maps all 13 `dot_511_*` sources; `live_targets.py` dispatches the new
  `dot_511_targets` kind to `registry_targets()`.
- `api_allowlist.toml`: API-mode entries for `services{,1,2,5}.arcgis.com`,
  `chartimap1.sha.maryland.gov`, `maps2.dcgis.dc.gov`, `data.wsdot.wa.gov` —
  documented ArcGIS REST query APIs, per-host rate limits, robots 4xx noted.
- `ops/cadence.toml`: monthly rows for the 8 green sources (days 24–27, 04:00 /
  06:00 UTC); gated states get no row — a recorded refusal is available via
  `run --mode live` (exit 3) without a scheduled job.
- `test_review_status.py` counts updated (157 registered / 52 loadable).

## Decisions / deviations

- **Pagination, not truncation:** the first live pass silently truncated
  hosted ArcGIS layers at 1,000 rows (`exceededTransferLimit`). Page targets +
  a last-page flag check were added; the defect is pinned by two tests
  (middle-page flag tolerated, last-page flag = drift).
- **WA/MO compact posture:** initially recorded `permission_granted_conditional`
  — corrected to `public_terms_only` because no outreach was performed (HG-04
  SKIPPED); the Stage-0 record consistency test enforces it. The conditional
  nature lives in the rights packets + notes, not a fabricated compact.
- **`SensitivityClass` config errors** get their own rejection reason
  (`invalid_sensitivity_class`) rather than masquerading as `no_registry_key`.
